$description: Motion durations, curves, distances and timing from the Motion page of the Humanbase Figma file (qc47Wo9Vj5lYjo9U7zdvWa).

instant.$description: Focus rings, closing menus, sorting, switching tab panels

fast.$description: Hover and press colors, checkbox and radio marks, tooltip fade

base.$description: Menus, selects and suggestions opening; segment and tab indicator; toast leaving

moderate.$description: Toasts arriving, dialogs and their backdrop, expanding rows, graph highlight

slow.$description: Drawers, the only element that moves a large area

enter.$description: Menus, toasts, dialogs and drawers arriving. Fast start, gentle stop.

exit.$description: Toasts, dialogs and drawers leaving. Gentle start, quick finish.

linear.$description: Opacity crossfades, the spinner and progress bars. No acceleration.

none.$description: Tooltips, focus rings, page content, table rows

xs.$description: Menus, selects and suggestions, down from their field

sm.$description: Toasts, up from the bottom edge

md.$description: Drawers, in from their edge while fading. Not the full width of the drawer.

dialog.$description: Dialogs grow from 98% to 100% while fading in. The page behind never scales.

response.$description: Every press, click or key gets visible feedback this fast, even if the result takes longer.

loading.$description: Show a spinner or skeleton only if waiting takes longer than this. Fast answers then appear without any flash.

tooltip.$description: Hover delay before a tooltip appears. Keyboard focus shows it at once.

loading.$description: Once shown, a loading indicator stays at least this long, so it doesn’t blink.

toast.$description: Plus 1s for every 20 words. Toasts with an action stay until dismissed, and pause while hovered or focused.
